name: visual-bible-campaign
description: Social campaign video for Visual Bible, rendered with HyperFrames

scripts.lint: npm run compose && hyperframes lint video && hyperframes lint video-wide
scripts.render:wide: npm run compose && hyperframes render video-wide --output renders/visual-bible-wide.mp4 --crf 19 --max-bitrate 16M --keyframe-interval 2
scripts.render: npm run render:vertical && npm run render:wide
